verdict.rationale: Formant ships AI features: an analytics AI assistant and plain-language fleet queries. An MCP-client capability is therefore a fair question for this platform, but nothing in the evidence shows users can connect external MCP servers so the product can use their tools. The webhooks, SDKs and llms.txt are adjacent features, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
